rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something without personal involvement or bias.

example.english: I will look at the matter impersonally and not take either side.
example.traditional: 我會客觀咁睇件事，唔偏幫任何一邊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui6 haak3 gun1 gam3 tai2 gin6 si6 m4 pin1 bong1 jam6 ho4 jat1 bin1

rows.note: Use this when someone handles a matter strictly as business or official procedure rather than personally.

example.english: Let's handle this impersonally this time and not relax the requirements just because we know each other.
example.traditional: 今次就公事公辦咁處理，唔好因為大家熟就放寬要求。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zau6 gung1 si6 gung1 baan6 gam3 cyu2 lei5 m4 hou2 jan1 wai6 daai6 gaa1 suk6 zau6 fong3 fun1 jiu1 kau4

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on showing no personal emotion or feelings.

example.english: They read out the letter impersonally.
example.traditional: 佢唔帶感情咁讀出封信。
example.jyutping: keoi5 m4 daai3 gam2 cing4 gam3 duk6 ceot1 fung1 seon3
